name: denodo
description: Create Denodo 9.5 objects from plain-language intent: databases, folders, tags, JDBC/DF/JSON data sources and wrappers, base, derived and interface views, associations, and Data Marketplace tags, categories and external elements, plus stored procedures — calling the predefined ones and writing your own in VQL — the full cache of a view: switching it on, loading, clearing — the metadata AI consumers read: an audit of view and field descriptions, primary keys, associations and the MCP visibility tag — metric views: KPIs defined once over a fact and its dimensions, and the views built on them — rows changed through a view: inserts, updates, deletes and upserts, previewed and applied after your yes — and query results stored as tables: remote tables and their refresh, summaries the optimizer answers aggregates from, data movement for federated joins, materialized tables.
